svg.desc: IMPLEMENTATION PLATE / 16 tables / Exact column names and SQL types / Domain (12) and technical auth/support (4)
svg.text: IMPLEMENTATION PLATE / 16 tables / Exact column names and SQL types / Domain (12) and technical auth/support (4)
PK = primary key (underlined) FK = foreign key UQ = unique NN = NOT NULL ? = nullable declaration D = SQL default
R# identifies an FK connector and the precise relationship register below. Counts: child → parent; parent → child. Lines are not inheritance.
All FK deletes RESTRICT except portal_session.account_id CASCADE. Academic FK updates CASCADE; extension FK updates default NO ACTION.
portal_account: role ∈ {admin, student}; admin ⇒ student_id NULL; student ⇒ student_id NOT NULL. student_id is UNIQUE; no faculty FK.
login_throttle and portal_migration have no FKs. SQL CHECKs, defaults, nullable TEXT primary-key caveat and application rules: see Portal_ER.md and schema JSON.
Sources: web/lib/schema.mjs + web/lib/portal.mjs • Editable SVG + reproducible generator • Original nine-table ER assets retained as historical.
